data.one_liner: Cross‑platform high‑performance logging using mmap and optional AES encryption via FFI.
data.what_it_does: Provides synchronous file logging on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and HarmonyOS with optional AES‑CFB‑128 encryption. It uses a native C/C++ core accessed through dart:ffi for fast writes and includes log‑file management and parsing utilities.
use_when: Need fast native logging without Dart overhead
Require encrypted log files on mobile/desktop
Want a single logger shared between Dart and native code
avoid_when: Prefer remote or cloud‑based logging services
Want a pure‑Dart solution with no native binaries
strengths: Very low‑latency native writes via mmap
Supports iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and HarmonyOS
Provides tools for parsing and analyzing log files
weaknesses: Requires native build steps and platform‑specific configuration
Increases app binary size with native libraries
No support for web or pure Dart logging
data.setup_notes: On iOS/macOS set Xcode Strip Style to 'Non‑Global Symbols' to keep FFI symbols. Ensure the bundled libmxlogger.so (Android/HarmonyOS) or mxlogger_ffi.dll (Windows) is included. No extra permissions beyond normal file storage are needed.
